policy.note: Classification is complete at file level; quarantine is intentional until a scoped runtime/DB/receipt control and negative boundary test are evidenced. A registry entry is not authorization.

precedence.current: Legacy routes may read users.role, roles.permissions, permission overrides, or route-local checks; each path remains quarantined until its decision source is evidenced.
precedence.corridorTarget: Signed active tenant context plus versioned grant/capability is deny-by-default and becomes the sole authorization source.
precedence.legacyRole: After corridor migration users.role is a read-only compatibility projection and must not grant access.
precedence.impersonation: External-tenant impersonation remains disabled until actor, target, tenant context, step-up, receipt, and unsafe-action deny tests pass.
